_comment: Synthetic demo dataset for App Store review / TestFlight first-run. All values are normal-range and physiologically plausible for a healthy ~38yo male, chosen NOT to trip lab_plausibility or any SafetyGuardian rule. NO efficacy / improved-outcome claims (R4-safe): these are realistic baseline records only. Consumed by backend/scripts/seed_demo_account.py.

observation_template._comment: Applied once per day for the last N days (N from --days, default 7). day_offset 0 = today. Values are constant baseline (no synthetic 'improvement' trend).

observation_every_other_day._comment: Applied on even day_offsets (0,2,4,6...) to vary cadence realistically.

timeline_seed_events._comment: build_timeline (events_timeline_service) reads ONLY WorkoutRecord / AnomalyAlert / GarminData(sleep_score<65) / Medication / MedicalExam. For a HEALTHY demo (no alerts, no poor-sleep, no meds) we seed clean POSITIVE workout events. NOTE: we deliberately seed ONLY workouts (not a MedicalExam) — workout events carry tz-AWARE occurred_at while exam events are tz-NAIVE, and build_timeline.events.sort() compares them directly, which raises TypeError when both kinds coexist (latent in production too). Two workouts keep occurred_at consistently aware and the timeline robustly non-empty.

agent_conversation._comment: Deterministic synthetic Agent conversation for App Store review screenshots. It is regenerated under a dedicated session_key and contains no diagnosis, medication, lab, or private-user data.
